title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash ef251d66663f… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: The OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors detected a malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash ef251d66663f4a97882fcdcf7622a377c2b3068c26763f73e1ec0a81136342dc. This file was observed 10 times on October 24, 2026, associated with attacker activity using the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer). The hash corresponds to a malicious payload that could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. No specific software versions or products are affected, and no known exploits in the wild have been reported. The threat is an indicator of compromise (IOC) useful for detection and response efforts.
